Observed on Headscale 0.29.3, relevant help excerpts:

`headscale --help` global flag:
      --force   Disable prompts and forces the execution

`headscale nodes delete --help`:
Usage:
  headscale nodes delete [flags]

Flags:
  -i, --identifier uint   Node identifier (ID)

The force switch is a global Headscale flag, not a nodes-delete flag.
